authenticity_review: The image demonstrates strong photorealism with excellent lighting, shadows, and texture rendering—particularly on the croissants (flaky layers, golden-brown crust) and candles (wax translucency, flame glow). However, two notable artifacts reduce authenticity: (1) Minor grounding failure at the base of the front-left candle where it blends into the table without a crisp contact shadow (severity 2 structural collapse); (2) The flower lacks a visible stem and appears to float or rest unnaturally on the table surface—a common AI artifact for cut flowers. Additionally, the fine_grained_classifier failed to identify the flower as any floral class (top prediction was 'candle'), suggesting the green dahlia-like morphology may be ambiguous or stylized. These issues prevent a perfect authenticity score but do not dominate the overall quality.
